sentences.text: Panxiosteus is an extinct genus of placoderm fish belonging to the arthrodire group.
The genus Panxiosteus was described by Wang in 1979.
Only one fossil occurrence of Panxiosteus has been recorded in the Paleobiology Database.
The type species of the genus Panxiosteus is Panxiosteus oculus, and the animal is classified as a member of the family Panxiosteidae.

A 2010 study placed Panxiosteidae as the sister taxon to Dunkleosteidae within the superfamily Dunkleosteoidea, but a 2016 study using a larger dataset recovered Panxiosteidae outside of Dunkleosteoidea, instead placing it within Coccosteoidea as the sister group of Coccosteidae.
Fossils of Panxiosteus date to the Givetian stage of the Middle Devonian, approximately 383.4 to 382.31 million years ago.
